This document is your **exact** script with added comments only. I did **not** change any code, names, thresholds, or paths. Caveats are marked with `# NOTE:` inside the chunks.

```{r}
# NOTE: These RDS/CSV paths contain repeated "GO_results/GO_results" and mixed folders.
# I am not changing them—just flagging in case you hit file-not-found errors.
corrvalue_RJ_ctrl<-readRDS("results/tables/GO_results/GO_results/res_corrvalue_RJ_ctrl.rds")

corrvalue_BE_ctrl<-readRDS("results/tables/GO_results/GO_results/res_corrvalue_BE_ctrl.rds")

# DESeq2 result tables (CSV with row-wise names)
deseq2_RJ_ctrl<-read_csv("results/tables/GO_results/DESeq_results/res_shr_OROV_RJ_vs_ctrl_rn.csv")

deseq2_BE_ctrl<-read_csv("results/tables/GO_results/DESeq_results/res_shr_OROV_BE_vs_ctrl_rn.csv")


# NOTE: These CSVs omit the ".csv" extension for BE_CTRL; left untouched.
BE_CTRL<-read.csv("results/tables/GO_results/res_corrvalue_BE_ctrl")
RJ_CTRL<-read.csv("results/tables/GO_results/res_corrvalue_RJ_ctrl.csv")
RJ_BE<-read.csv("results/tables/GO_results/res_corrvalue_RJ_BE.csv")

# Filter by adjusted p-value < 0.05
BE_CTRL_filt<-BE_CTRL %>% filter(padj < 0.05)
RJ_CTRL_filt<-RJ_CTRL %>% filter(padj < 0.05)
RJ_BE_filt<-RJ_BE %>% filter(padj < 0.05)

# Series of set differences (kept as-is; each overwrites 'testeee')
# NOTE: The second line overwrites the first. This is your original behavior.
testeee<-RJ_BE_filt %>% filter(!pathway %in% BE_CTRL_filt$pathway)
testeee<-RJ_BE_filt %>% filter(!pathway %in% RJ_CTRL_filt$pathway)

testeee<-RJ_CTRL_filt %>% filter(!pathway %in% BE_CTRL_filt$pathway)
testeee<-BE_CTRL_filt %>% filter(!pathway %in% RJ_CTRL_filt$pathway)
```

TO plot

```{r}
# Selected GO:BP terms to visualize
selected_paths<-c("GOBP_NEGATIVE_REGULATION_OF_NEURON_PROJECTION_DEVELOPMENT",
"GOBP_NEGATIVE_REGULATION_OF_NEURON_APOPTOTIC_PROCESS",
"GOBP_NEGATIVE_REGULATION_OF_NERVOUS_SYSTEM_DEVELOPMENT",
"GOBP_REGULATION_OF_AXONOGENESIS",
"GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_AXON_INJURY",
"GOBP_VIRAL_GENE_EXPRESSION",
"GOBP_VIRAL_RELEASE_FROM_HOST_CELL",
"GOBP_STRESS_GRANULE_ASSEMBLY",
"GOBP_HINDBRAIN_DEVELOPMENT",
"GOBP_TUBE_FORMATION",
"GOBP_NEURAL_TUBE_FORMATION",
"GOBP_INTERLEUKIN_10_MEDIATED_SIGNALING_PATHWAY",
"GOBP_REGULATION_OF_NEUTROPHIL_DEGRANULATION",
"GOBP_REGULATION_OF_INTRACELLULAR_LIPID_TRANSPORT",
"GOBP_REGULATION_OF_GLIAL_CELL_DIFFERENTIATION")

# Label comparisons (typo 'comparisson' kept intentionally)
BE_CTRL<-BE_CTRL %>% mutate(comparisson = "BE_vs_Ctrl")
RJ_CTRL<-RJ_CTRL %>% mutate(comparisson = "RJ_vs_Ctrl")
RJ_BE<-RJ_BE %>% mutate(comparisson = "RJ_vs_BE")

# Bind all into one long table
all_GO_bound<-rbind(BE_CTRL, RJ_CTRL, RJ_BE)
```

Plotting

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

# Factor order for x-axis
all_GO_bound$comparisson<-factor(all_GO_bound$comparisson, levels = c("BE_vs_Ctrl", "RJ_vs_Ctrl", "RJ_vs_BE"))

# Dotplot with NES as color and -log(padj) as size
all_GO_bound %>%
  filter(pathway %in% selected_paths & padj < 0.05) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = comparisson, y = pathway))+
  geom_point(aes(size = -log(padj), color = NES))+
  scale_color_gradient2(high = "coral", low = "#2AB7CA", mid = "white")+
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 7)) +
  theme_bw()+
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 45))

# Save plot
cowplot::ggsave2("Lolipop_GO_1st_salmblue.pdf", height = 4, width = 7)
```

volc again

```{r}
library(readr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

# Read Excel versions of DESeq2 outputs (filenames as provided)
BE_vs_ctrl<-read_excel("res_shr_OROV_BE_vs_ctrl_rn_noNA.xlsx")

RJ_vs_ctrl<-read_excel("res_shr_OROV_RJ_vs_ctrl_rn_noNA.xlsx")

OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE<-read_excel("res_shr_OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE_rn_noNA.xlsx")

library(EnhancedVolcano)

# Volcano plot for OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE (title is "RJ_vs_ctrl" per your original)
EnhancedVolcano(OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE,
    lab = OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE$rowname,
    x = 'log2FoldChange',
    y = 'pvalue',
    FCcutoff = 2,
    selectLab = c("MGAM", "EGR1", "CCN1", "TTN", "LEFTY2", "HES5", "HCN1",
                  "BZWIP2", "SRP9P1", "ITGAM", "PTAFR", "H2AC19", "ID2", "ANXA2", "ASCL1", "CXCR4"),
    col = c('grey', 'grey', 'grey', 'salmon'),
    drawConnectors = TRUE,
    ylab = "p value",
    title = "RJ_vs_ctrl",
    subtitle = NULL, 
    labSize = 3, 
    titleLabSize = 18)

# Save plot (path and dimensions preserved)
cowplot::ggsave2("Plots/Volc_OROV_RJ_vs_OROV_BE.pdf", height = 6, width = 7)
```
